notes: 영어 녹음 대본. text 는 한국어 키(맵 열쇠), en 과 segs 는 영어만(한글 0자). 목소리는 voice_script_el.json 과 같은 배역. 원작 시 1844 판본 구절, 두 행을 한 줄로 묶은 곳은 행 끝에서 쉼(" / " 자리).

lines.text: 크리스마스 전날 밤, 집 안은 고요해요.
lines.en: 'Twas the night before Christmas, when all through the house
segs: 'Twas the night before Christmas, when all through the house

lines.text: 쥐 한 마리도 꼼짝 안 해요. 새근새근, 쿨쿨.
lines.en: Not a creature was stirring, not even a mouse;
segs: Not a creature was stirring, not even a mouse;

lines.text: 벽난로 옆엔 양말을 걸었어요. 조심조심, 나란히.
lines.en: The stockings were hung by the chimney with care,
segs: The stockings were hung by the chimney with care,

lines.en: In hopes that St. Nicholas soon would be there;
segs: In hopes that St. Nicholas soon would be there;

lines.en: Outside, the snow fell softly, softly down.
segs: Outside, the snow fell softly, softly down.

lines.text: 아이들은 이불 속에 포옥, 새근새근 잠들었어요.
lines.en: The children were nestled all snug in their beds,
segs: The children were nestled all snug in their beds,

lines.text: 머릿속엔 달콤한 사탕들이 빙글빙글 춤을 춰요.
lines.en: While visions of sugar-plums danced in their heads;
segs: While visions of sugar-plums danced in their heads;

lines.en: And mamma in her 'kerchief, and I in my cap,
segs: And mamma in her 'kerchief, and I in my cap,

lines.en: Had just settled our brains for a long winter's nap,
segs: Had just settled our brains for a long winter's nap,

lines.en: When out on the lawn there arose such a clatter,
segs: When out on the lawn there arose such a clatter,

lines.en: I sprang from the bed to see what was the matter.
segs: I sprang from the bed to see what was the matter.

lines.en: Away to the window I flew like a flash,
segs: Away to the window I flew like a flash,

lines.en: Tap the window!
Tore open the shutters and threw up the sash.
segs: Tore open the shutters and threw up the sash.

lines.text: 새하얀 눈 위에 달빛이 비쳐, 낮처럼 환해요.
lines.en: The moon on the breast of the new-fallen snow Gave the lustre of mid-day to objects below,
segs: The moon on the breast of the new-fallen snow Gave the lustre of mid-day to objects below,

lines.en: When, what to my wondering eyes should appear,
segs: When, what to my wondering eyes should appear,

lines.text: 조그만 썰매 하나, 조그만 순록 여덟 마리!
lines.en: But a miniature sleigh, and eight tiny reindeer,
segs: But a miniature sleigh, and eight tiny reindeer,

lines.text: 썰매를 몰고 온 작은 할아버지, 날쌔고 재빨라요.
lines.en: With a little old driver, so lively and quick,
segs: With a little old driver, so lively and quick,

lines.en: I knew in a moment it must be St. Nick.
segs: I knew in a moment it must be St. Nick.

lines.en: More rapid than eagles his coursers they came,
segs: More rapid than eagles his coursers they came,

lines.text: 할아버지가 휘익 휘파람을 불고, 이름을 하나하나 불렀어요.
lines.en: And he whistled, and shouted, and called them by name;
segs: And he whistled, and shouted, and called them by name;

lines.text: 이랴, 대셔! 이랴, 댄서! 이랴, 프랜서, 빅슨!
lines.en: "Now, Dasher! now, Dancer! now, Prancer and Vixen!
segs: "Now, Dasher! now, Dancer! now, Prancer and Vixen!

lines.text: 가자, 코밋! 가자, 큐피드! 가자, 돈더, 블리첸!
lines.en: On, Comet! on, Cupid! on, Donder and Blitzen!
segs: On, Comet! on, Cupid! on, Donder and Blitzen!

lines.en: To the top of the porch! to the top of the wall!
segs: To the top of the porch! to the top of the wall!

lines.en: Now dash away! dash away! dash away all!"
segs: Now dash away! dash away! dash away all!"

lines.en: As dry leaves that before the wild hurricane fly, When they meet with an obstacle, mount to the sky,
segs: As dry leaves that before the wild hurricane fly, When they meet with an obstacle, mount to the sky,

lines.en: So up to the house-top the coursers they flew,
segs: So up to the house-top the coursers they flew,

lines.en: With the sleigh full of toys, and St. Nicholas too.
segs: With the sleigh full of toys, and St. Nicholas too.

lines.text: 눈 깜짝할 사이에 소리가 들려요. 또각또각, 작은 발굽 소리.
lines.en: And then, in a twinkling, I heard on the roof The prancing and pawing of each little hoof.
segs: And then, in a twinkling, I heard on the roof The prancing and pawing of each little hoof.

lines.text: 소리가 어디서 날까요? 지붕 위를 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Where is the sound coming from? Tap the top of the roof!
segs: Where is the sound coming from? Tap the top of the roof!

lines.en: Not there. The sound is coming from up above.
segs: Not there. The sound is coming from up above.

lines.en: Up on the roof, clip-clop, tap-tap!
segs: Up on the roof, clip-clop, tap-tap!

lines.text: 나는 얼른 고개를 넣고 몸을 돌렸어요.
lines.en: As I drew in my head, and was turning around,
segs: As I drew in my head, and was turning around,

lines.en: And then!

lines.text: 굴뚝에서 산타 할아버지가 쿵 하고 내려왔어요!
lines.en: Down the chimney St. Nicholas came with a bound.
segs: Down the chimney St. Nicholas came with a bound.

lines.text: 머리부터 발끝까지 털옷을 입었어요. 옷엔 재와 그을음이 잔뜩.
lines.en: He was dressed all in fur, from his head to his foot, And his clothes were all tarnished with ashes and soot;
segs: He was dressed all in fur, from his head to his foot, And his clothes were all tarnished with ashes and soot;

lines.text: 등에는 장난감 꾸러미를 짊어졌어요. 보따리를 막 푸는 장난감 장수 같아요.
lines.en: A bundle of toys he had flung on his back, And he looked like a peddler just opening his pack.
segs: A bundle of toys he had flung on his back, And he looked like a peddler just opening his pack.

lines.en: His eyes, how they twinkled! his dimples, how merry!
segs: His eyes, how they twinkled! his dimples, how merry!

lines.en: His cheeks were like roses,

lines.text: 코는 무엇처럼 빨갈까요? 빨간 것을 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: What is his nose as red as? Tap the red one!
segs: What is his nose as red as? Tap the red one!

lines.text: 그건 하얀 색이에요. 빨간 것은 어디 있을까요?
lines.en: That one is white. Where is the red one?
segs: That one is white. Where is the red one?

lines.text: 그건 노란 색이에요. 빨간 것은 어디 있을까요?
lines.en: That one is yellow. Where is the red one?
segs: That one is yellow. Where is the red one?

lines.en: his nose like a cherry!
His droll little mouth was drawn up like a bow,
segs: His droll little mouth was drawn up like a bow,

lines.text: 수염은 무엇처럼 하얄까요? 하얀 것을 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: What is his beard as white as? Tap the white one!
segs: What is his beard as white as? Tap the white one!

lines.text: 그건 빨간 색이에요. 하얀 것은 어디 있을까요?
lines.en: That one is red. Where is the white one?
segs: That one is red. Where is the white one?

lines.text: 그건 노란 색이에요. 하얀 것은 어디 있을까요?
lines.en: That one is yellow. Where is the white one?
segs: That one is yellow. Where is the white one?

lines.en: And the beard of his chin was as white as the snow;
segs: And the beard of his chin was as white as the snow;

lines.en: He had a broad face and a little round belly,
segs: He had a broad face and a little round belly,

lines.en: That shook, when he laughed, like a bowlful of jelly.
segs: That shook, when he laughed, like a bowlful of jelly.

lines.text: 통통하고 똥똥한, 유쾌한 꼬마 요정 할아버지.
lines.en: He was chubby and plump, a right jolly old elf,
segs: He was chubby and plump, a right jolly old elf,

lines.en: And I laughed when I saw him, in spite of myself;
segs: And I laughed when I saw him, in spite of myself;

lines.en: A wink of his eye and a twist of his head,
segs: A wink of his eye and a twist of his head,

lines.en: Soon gave me to know I had nothing to dread;
segs: Soon gave me to know I had nothing to dread;

lines.text: 할아버지는 한마디도 없이 곧장 일을 시작했어요.
lines.en: He spoke not a word, but went straight to his work,
segs: He spoke not a word, but went straight to his work,

lines.text: 선물을 어디에 넣을까요? 양말 속을 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Where do the presents go? Tap inside the stocking!
segs: Where do the presents go? Tap inside the stocking!

lines.en: Not there. Right inside the stocking!
segs: Not there. Right inside the stocking!

lines.en: And filled all the stockings;
then turned with a jerk,

lines.text: 코 옆에 손가락을 대고 고개를 끄덕.
lines.en: And laying his finger aside of his nose, And giving a nod,
segs: And laying his finger aside of his nose, And giving a nod,

lines.en: up the chimney he rose;

lines.text: 썰매에 폴짝 올라 휘익 휘파람을 불자,
lines.en: He sprang to his sleigh, to his team gave a whistle,
segs: He sprang to his sleigh, to his team gave a whistle,

lines.en: And away they all flew like the down of a thistle.
segs: And away they all flew like the down of a thistle.

lines.text: 저 멀리 사라지기 전에, 할아버지 목소리가 들렸어요.
lines.en: But I heard him exclaim, ere he drove out of sight,
segs: But I heard him exclaim, ere he drove out of sight,

lines.en: Tap the sleigh!

lines.text: 모두 모두 메리 크리스마스! 모두 모두 잘 자요!
lines.en: "Happy Christmas to all, and to all a good-night!"
segs: "Happy Christmas to all, and to all a good-night!"

lines.text: 집 안은 다시 고요해요. 모두 포근히 잘 자요.
lines.en: The house was quiet once more. Good night, everyone.
segs: The house was quiet once more. Good night, everyone.
